I need to find what Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd bought on November 1, 1956, following an April Budget that year.

In 1956, the UK introduced Premium Bonds following the April Budget. Premium Bonds were a new government savings scheme announced by Chancellor Harold Macmillan in his April 1956 Budget. They went on sale on November 1, 1956.

Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd, who was Lord Mayor of London from 1955-1956, purchased the first Premium Bond on that date.

Answer: Premium Bond
Confidence: 0.95
